name: latin_pop
what: Reggaeton and latin pop production from Bien Duro (docs/demo_study): the dembow drops out for a beat before each chorus with an impact on the one, a reverse fill on the vocal chops into the chorus, a filter dip into the verse, and a medium pump on the bass and the music bus (Bien Duro pumps with Gross Beat; its loudest section swings 4.9 dB).
section_gains_how: Not applied blind: after the first render read measure_section_levels' contrast and run apply_section_gains with by_role {'scale': x}, aiming from the measured slope (tools/remix_song.py does this).
